detail.not_aligned: Observed Gameplay and Cinematic camera aspect or FOV values differ.
detail.cannot_assess: There is not enough runtime evidence to compare camera paths.
detail.waiting: Waiting for a current Cinematic camera observation to compare with the Gameplay boundary sample.
detail.expected_seamless: The selected settings are expected to provide a seamless camera transition. Runtime verification is pending until a Cinematic camera observation is available.

transition.context_active_selection: Assessment uses the active cinematic selection.
transition.context_next_selection: Assessment uses settings for the next cinematic selection.

detail.gameplay_incomplete: Gameplay status is not available yet.
detail.gameplay_hook_unavailable: The Gameplay camera integration is unavailable.
detail.camera_update_waiting: Waiting for the required camera update.
detail.native_recalculation_persists: The result of a native camera recalculation may persist until the game or save is reloaded.
detail.gameplay_context_unavailable: Gameplay camera information is not available.
detail.horplus_waiting: Waiting for Gameplay camera data before HorPlus can become active.
detail.horplus_active: Gameplay HorPlus is enabled, its baseline is usable, and the coordinator is in Gameplay.
detail.native_recalculation_enabled: The game's native camera adjustment is enabled.
detail.cinematic_incomplete: Cinematic status is not available yet.
detail.cinematic_disabled: Cinematic corrections are disabled; the game’s native camera output is used.
detail.cinematic_native_ready: Cinematic corrections are disabled; the game’s native camera output is used.
detail.next_cinematic_ready: Changes take effect from the next cinematic.
detail.cinematic_active: A cinematic is active with the selected aspect and FOV modes.
detail.dialogue_incomplete: Dialogue status is not available yet.
detail.dialogue_mode_unavailable: The selected Dialogue zoom mode is unavailable.
detail.dialogue_native_ready: Dialogue correction is off; the game's camera behavior is unchanged.
detail.dialogue_adaptive_ready: Adaptive zoom is configured for the next dialogue.
detail.dialogue_reduced_ready: Reduced zoom is configured for the next dialogue.
detail.dialogue_disabled_ready: No additional dialogue zoom will be applied.
detail.dialogue_ready: Changes take effect from the next dialogue.
detail.dialogue_active: The current dialogue is using the active zoom mode shown.
detail.dialogue_starting: Waiting for the Dialogue transition to be confirmed.
detail.active_dialogue_policy_unavailable: The active Dialogue zoom setting is unavailable.
detail.dialogue_ending: Dialogue camera is returning to Gameplay.

gameplay.disabled: Stop further Gameplay correction and leave the game's original camera/aspect behavior in control. The result of a native camera recalculation may persist until the game or save is reloaded.
gameplay.horplus: Preserves Gameplay writer FOV changes and transforms each sample using the aspect observed at that writer, including during zoom.
gameplay.aspect_recalculation: Uses the game's native aspect transition while preserving the selected Gameplay FOV. On custom windowed aspects, restoring Auto may return the window to its native aspect and size.
gameplay.runtime_combine: Combines the former Aspect Recalculation and HorPlus modes for seamless transitions between Gameplay and cinematics. It synchronizes the Gameplay camera aspect with the current window aspect instead of relying on the value captured when the camera was loaded, and resynchronizes it when the display resolution changes. Hor+ FOV correction is applied only after synchronization is confirmed. This is the recommended mode for smooth transitions into and out of cinematics.

cinematics.enabled: When enabled, applies the selected cinematic framing and FOV corrections. When disabled, Camera Tweaks leaves cinematic camera output native.

aspect.auto: Uses the current runtime viewport aspect for cinematic framing. Supports arbitrary valid aspect ratios.
aspect.native: Native behavior is controlled by the separate Enabled switch; framing choices are Auto, 16:9, 21:9 and 32:9.
aspect.16_9: Uses 16:9 framing for cinematics, regardless of the display aspect.
aspect.21_9: Uses 21:9 framing for cinematics, regardless of the display aspect.
aspect.32_9: Uses 32:9 framing for cinematics, regardless of the display aspect.
aspect.forced_example: Example: 32:9 on a 16:9 display produces wider framing with black bars above and below.

fov.gameplay: Follows current Gameplay FOV while preserving cinematic variation. Falls back to NativeHorPlus if needed context is unavailable.
fov.native: Applies HorPlus to the authored cinematic FOV, independently of the player's Gameplay FOV setting.

dialogue.enabled: When Dialogue correction is disabled, the game uses its native dialogue zoom, which defaults to a 70° FOV.

zoom.adaptive: Preserve the game's original optical zoom strength relative to current Gameplay FOV.
zoom.reduced: Use half of the Adaptive optical zoom strength.
zoom.disabled: Disable dialogue zoom and keep current Gameplay FOV.

hotkeys.enabled: Enable Gameplay, Cinematic and Dialogue hotkey actions.
hotkeys.disabled: Disable these actions. Overlay Toggle remains active independently.
hotkeys.change: Click the current key control to start rebinding.
hotkeys.change_overlay: Click the current overlay key control to start rebinding.
hotkeys.single_key: Bind a single ordinary keyboard key. Modifier combinations and mouse buttons are not supported.
hotkeys.rebind: Press a key to assign it. Press Esc to cancel.
hotkeys.gameplay_cycle: Cycles the Gameplay correction immediately: AspectRecalculation -> HorPlus -> RuntimeCombine -> AspectRecalculation.
hotkeys.cinematic_aspect_cycle: Cycles framing for the next cinematic: Auto -> 16:9 -> 21:9 -> 32:9 -> Auto.
hotkeys.cinematic_fov_cycle: Sets the FOV mode for the next cinematic: NativeHorPlus -> GameplayHorPlus -> NativeHorPlus. Does not affect a cinematic already playing.
hotkeys.dialogue_cycle: Cycles the Dialogue correction mode for the next dialogue: Adaptive -> Reduced -> Disabled -> Adaptive. Does not affect a dialogue already in progress.

overlay.always_active: Use this key to open or close the overlay.

runtime.viewport: The current aspect ratio of the game's client viewport. It can change with the game resolution or window size.
runtime.writer_aspect: The aspect currently observed from the Gameplay camera writer. It is separate from the client viewport aspect.
runtime.policy_aspect: The aspect used by the current Gameplay FOV-policy observation. It is not a final projection-aspect readback.
runtime.viewport_auto: The cinematic Auto aspect policy uses this viewport aspect as its target.
runtime.viewport_unavailable: Current client viewport dimensions are unavailable.
runtime.aspect_matched: Observed Gameplay and Cinematic camera aspect values match within the comparison tolerance.
runtime.aspect_mismatch: Observed Gameplay and Cinematic camera aspect values differ.
runtime.aspect_cannot_assess: There is not enough valid runtime information to compare the ratios.
runtime.cinematic_aspect: This is a UI preview from the active or next selection and the current client ratio. Production may fall back to display or native aspect when client dimensions are unavailable; this is not confirmation of the applied cinematic aspect or final projection.
runtime.cinematic_default: The game's default camera behavior is used; Camera Tweaks does not change the aspect or FOV.
runtime.cinematic_aspect_unavailable: A valid selected cinematic target or game-window client ratio is unavailable.
runtime.gameplay_fov: The retained neutral Gameplay writer FOV observed under stable, non-zoom conditions. It is not a configured FOV or final visible FOV.
runtime.gameplay_fov_unavailable: A valid neutral Gameplay FOV has not been observed yet.
runtime.native_fov: The native FOV observed at the applicable camera transaction input before this mod's correction. It may change between Gameplay, Cinematic, Dialogue and recovery transactions.
runtime.native_fov_unavailable: A valid current native FOV is unavailable.
runtime.horplus_fov: The correction-policy target FOV carried or produced for the applicable camera transaction. This is distinct from the FOV returned by that transaction.
runtime.horplus_fov_unavailable: A valid correction-policy target FOV is unavailable.
runtime.current_output_fov: FOV returned by the current mod camera transaction after its applicable correction policy.
runtime.transition_evidence: Stored evidence from an accepted Cinematic ENTER boundary; this is separate from live camera state.
runtime.transition_generation: Cinematic lifecycle generation associated with this accepted ENTER evidence.
runtime.gameplay_boundary_aspect: Gameplay-side aspect captured at the accepted Gameplay-to-Cinematic ENTER boundary.
runtime.cinematic_enter_aspect: Cinematic-side aspect captured at the accepted ENTER boundary.
runtime.aspect_delta: Absolute difference between the Gameplay Boundary Aspect and Cinematic ENTER Aspect.
runtime.gameplay_boundary_fov: Gameplay-side FOV captured at ENTER; this is transition evidence, not a live FOV reading.
runtime.cinematic_enter_fov: Cinematic-side FOV captured at ENTER; this is transition evidence, not a live FOV reading.
runtime.fov_delta: Absolute difference between the Gameplay Boundary FOV and Cinematic ENTER FOV.
runtime.fov_match: Comparison of captured boundary FOV values using the semantic ±1° tolerance.
runtime.camera_transition: Overall assessment of the validated Gameplay-to-Cinematic boundary using available aspect and FOV evidence.
runtime.gameplay_status: Current presentation status of the Gameplay camera integration.
runtime.cinematic_status: Current presentation status of Cinematic camera integration.

camera_state.waiting: Waiting for the first complete camera update.

value.runtime_combine_detail: Before: {before}; target: {target}; after: {after}; mismatch: {mismatch}; write attempted: {attempted}; write succeeded: {write_succeeded}; confirmed: {confirmed}; flags: {flags_before} → {flags_after}; FOV: {input_fov} → {output_fov}.

notification.persistence_failed: The change is active but was not saved. The previous value will return when the game restarts.
